basics.name: Shibu John Raphael
basics.title: Front-End Architect | AI-Augmented Developer
summary:
Front-End Developer (React.js) with 5+ years of hands-on experience building scalable, performant, and responsive web applications, backed by 10+ years of strong UI/UX expertise. Specialized in React.js, Redux, JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind  CSS, Material UI, Bootstrap, Shadcn UI, and component-driven architecture. Experienced in micro-frontend development using Module Federation, reusable component libraries, performance optimization, REST API integration, and modern build pipelines
.

Bringing a unique hybrid strength of intuitive design thinking + high-quality engineering, ensuring pixel-perfect, accessible, and user-focused interfaces. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams, modernizing front-end workflows, integrating AI-assisted development tools, and driving consistent UI engineering practices.

React.js Front-End Engineering: Tailwind CSS, Material UI, Bootstrap, Shadcn UI
Reusable component libraries & UI style guide maintenance
UX & Product Design: UX research, usability testing, heuristic evaluations
Wireframes, user flows, prototypes, interaction design
